items.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s creative plan to pay California’s proposed billionaire tax without losing control of Meta
items.summary: A newly launched stock class being offered was partially engineered to help Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg pay the "billionaire's tax," should the measure be voted into law.
items.creator: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear
items.summary: Warhound, the brainchild of Ben Lamm and Palmer Luckey, emerges from stealth to genetically engineer dogs for military and law enforcement.
items.creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
